key_difference: (D) patches only cleanupThreadData() instead of centralizing in QThreadData::clearEvents(); it interleaves unposting with deleting and has no pass cap, so an event destructor that destroys another receiver in the same batch leaves a dangling pe.receiver, and a destructor that always reposts loops forever. (B) avoids both by unposting the whole batch before any deletion and capping at MaxPasses.
